### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the change to preserve numeric precision in structured JSON display. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes structured JSON display rounding in chat messages (#3866) by preserving numeric text instead of re-serializing parsed numbers. **Changes:** - Uses token-based pretty-printing to preserve large integers and other numeric representations. - Retains JSON validation, string normalization, and compact empty objects and arrays. - Adds regression tests for numeric precision, nesting, and escaped strings. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `frontend/​src/​components/​Chat/​messageViewModel.ts` | Pretty-prints validated JSON while preserving numeric tokens exactly. | | `frontend/​src/​components/​Chat/​messageViewModel.test.ts` | Tests numeric preservation and formatting compatibility. |
Review effort: Balanced
